name: effect-confetti-button
title: Confetti Burst
description: Bấm HOÀN TẤT, nút tô màu nảy nhẹ đổi thành dấu tích XONG, viền loé ra và 28 mảnh pháo giấy bung lên rồi rơi theo trọng lực.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-button-confetti-burst, written here): Pill 140x44 outlined; at 0.62 s it fills accent, label COMPLETE → ✓ DONE, pop 1 → 1.1 → 1 (half sine, 0.22 s); an outline flash grows 10 px and fades over 0.3 s. 28 pieces 8x5 r1 (accent / blue / yellow / green), seeded: x0 = centre ± 50 px, angle up ± 75°, speed 110-200 px/s with drag (x = v (1 − e^(−1.8 s)) / 1.8), gravity y += 90 s², x wobble ±4 px, flip scaleX = cos(5-13 rad/s), spin 2 rad/s; fade 1.0-1.5 s after launch. Params: at (0.62 s) · pieces (28) · speed (110-200 px/s) · gravity (180 px/s²) · seed (61).
